subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Contract Types
description: Learn Contract Types in one minute.

hook.text: A fixed-price contract seemed safe until raw materials spiked 40%. The supplier couldn't deliver without losing money.

buildup.text: Contract types allocate risk differently: fixed-price, cost-plus, time-and-materials, and incentive contracts.

discovery.text: Fixed-price shifts risk to the supplier. Cost-plus shifts it to the buyer. Incentive contracts share it.

twist.text: Choosing the wrong type guarantees disputes. Uncertainty needs flexibility; certainty allows fixed terms.

climax.text: Experienced buyers match contract type to risk level—fixed for commodities, flexible for complex services.

punchline.text: The contract type defines who bears the risk.

quiz.question: Who bears more risk in a fixed-price contract?
